address: Kuruçeşme Mahallesi, Yol Sokak No:2, Ulus/Beşiktaş, Istanbul, 34345, Türkiye
bio: Sunset Grill & Bar could be in a Hollywood film. This spacious, upscale restaurant is located in the heights of Ulus Park, providing a magnificent view of the city and the Bosporus – be sure to ask for a table by the window. The well-heeled clientele is drawn by the attentive service, and the extensive menu, which features classic French cuisine, Asian-inspired dishes and trendy sushi options, as well as the impressive wine list. Treat yourself to one of the barbecue specialities – think butter-soft beef fillet with a brown sauce enhanced with yuzu and mustard. An exhilarating dining experience!
